evidence.title: 3-Month Treasury Constant Maturity Rate
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was 0.01 percentage points; it resolved to 'no'.

evidence.title: Monthly Market Wrap: July 2023 - YCharts
evidence.summary: This source provides the 3-month Treasury rate for July 2023 and notes a significant increase in short-term yields during that month, which is directly relevant to understanding the baseline and recent trends for the target yield.

evidence.title: Bond market sees no end to tumult as Federal Reserve casts a hawkish shadow | World News - Business Standard
evidence.summary: This article, published in mid-August, discusses the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance and its potential impact on Treasury yields, including short-term ones. It highlights uncertainty and potential for continued volatility.

evidence.title: Inflection point in global monetary policy
evidence.summary: This report, published at the beginning of August, provides an overview of global monetary policy, including the US Fed's actions and market expectations for rate cuts, which directly impacts short-term Treasury yields.

evidence.title: US IG Primary Market Wrap July 2023
evidence.summary: This report summarizes the US investment grade market in July 2023, noting that yields on average were almost unmoved. This provides context for the stability of broader bond market yields leading into August.

evidence.title: 2023 Midyear Update: Fed Signals Amid Mixed Economy
evidence.summary: This mid-year update provides a broader context of the bond market and Fed actions up to July, noting that yields had risen again by midyear due to economic resilience. This sets the stage for the environment in August.

evidence.title: Soft CPI Surprise Pushes Down USD Forward Curves, Encourages Flows Into Carry Trades | ϕpost: News & Analyses of Capital Markets
evidence.summary: This article from mid-July indicates that a 'soft CPI surprise' pushed down USD forward curves. While not directly about the 3-month yield, it suggests a downward pressure on future rate expectations due to inflation data, which could influence short-term yields.
